info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Osprey Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of detailed product information for the Osprey Jacket within the catalog. It allows users to add comprehensive attributes, features, and specifications to enhance product visibility. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that aim to provide detailed and accurate product listings. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure that customers receive up-to-date and complete information about the Osprey Jacket, thus improving the overall shopping experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information for the Osprey Jacket, enabling better clarity and functionality for product listings.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for an Osprey jacket, including all necessary parameters for processing. Ensure that all required fields are populated according to the specified schema. The information submitted will be used for various operations related to the Osprey jacket.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the jacket details.

CreateCatalogOspreyJacketDetailRequest.title: Osprey Jacket Order Request

osprey_jacket_id.description: The unique identifier for the Osprey jacket being ordered.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the order.

quantity.description: The number of Osprey jackets to be ordered.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order should be considered a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Osprey jacket.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the order for classification.

items.description: A tag that provides additional information about the order.

CreateCatalogOspreyJacketDetailRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for creating an order for an Osprey jacket. It includes details such as the jacket ID, requester information, quantity, priority status, unit price, and associated tags.

CreateCatalogOspreyJacketDetailResponse_.title: Osprey Jacket Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the record that was processed.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the processing was completed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records that matched the criteria during the operation.

warnings.description: A list of warnings generated during the processing of the request.
example: Warning: Some records were not processed due to validation errors.

CreateCatalogOspreyJacketDetailResponse_.description: This schema represents the response structure for the Osprey Jacket details operation after a POST request. It includes the status of the operation, a record ID for referencing the entry, the time when the processing was completed, the count of matched records, and any warnings generated during the operation.

warnings: Warning: Some records were not processed due to validation errors.
